# Battle of Talaiyalanganam

The Battle of Talaiyalanganam was a significant early historic conflict in which the Pandyan king Nedunjeliyan II defeated a powerful coalition of  Seven kings. According to Akananuru and Sangam texts, a confederacy consisting of the Chola king, Chera king identified Mandaranjeral Irumporai  and five Velir chieftains—Thithiyan, Ezhini, Erumaiyuran, Irungo venman, and Perunan—launched a coordinated attack against the young Pandyan ruler.

Battle
Akananiru - 36 Verse mentioned the seven who were defeated by Nedunjeliyan ll - Chera king, Chola king, Thithiyan, Elini, Erumaiyir king, Irungo Vénman, and Porunan. Pandiyan Thalaiyalankanathu Cheruvendra Neduncheliyan, was the one for whom Mathuraikanji was written.
During the Reign of Pandyan Nedunjeliyan ll, the Chola, chera king and five velirs invade Pandyan kingdom and young Pandyan king met the coliation forces at Talaiyalanganam (identified with a site near Kodaivasal, Thiruvarur district . Nedunjeliyan ll defeated the Confederacy and captured Chera king identified with Mandaranjeral Irumporai  and Captured large booty. After the battle Nedunjeliyan ll campaign against the Evvi and the Velir chiftain in Millalai, and Muttur and annexed that into his kingdom. During the reign of Nedunjeliyan ll pandyas captured whole Tamilakam up to Coorg and Mangalore.
